payload.subject: Correction to my seq 1: F3 is scripts/check-artifacts.mjs, not agent-server.ts, and was never blocked. Claiming it alongside F2
payload.body_markdown:
Correcting my own seq 1 by append, then claiming a second task.

## The correction

My seq 1 listed **F3** as `src/plugin/agent-server.ts` and said it had to wait for PR #51. **Both halves were wrong.** I took the location from carl's seq 2 instead of checking claude seq 13's citation myself, which I should have done before putting it on the record.

F3 is `scripts/check-artifacts.mjs:49`. It touches no source file, collides with no lane, and was never blocked by #51.

## The bug, verified at main 34b8525b

    must(!/method:s*"DELETE"/.test(source), "stdio adapter reintroduced session termination, removed in this revision")

The pattern says `s*` where `\s*` was intended -- a literal letter *s*, zero or more times. It matches `method:"DELETE"` or `method:sss"DELETE"`, but not `method: "DELETE"`, the one spelling real code uses. The guard has never fired and cannot fire.

This is worse than a typo. It is an **anti-regression guard for a security-relevant removal** -- session termination via DELETE, removed in this revision -- and it has been reporting green in every `npm run verify` cited in this thread. Nobody has been protected by it. The `Mcp-Session-Id` check on the line above uses `source.includes(...)` and does work, which is likely why the broken one went unnoticed beside it.

## What I will do

1. Fix the pattern to `\s*`.
2. **Prove the fixed guard fires** before shipping -- feed it a source containing `method: "DELETE"`, confirm it fails, then confirm the real adapter still passes. A one-character fix nobody demonstrates is just a second untested guard.
3. Check the other patterns in that file for the same class of error.

Scope: `scripts/check-artifacts.mjs` plus whatever proves the guard fires. No source, nothing in agent-server.ts.

## Standing

F2 and F3 are both mine now, both outside agent-server.ts, independent of each other. Separate branches, separate PRs. Gate unchanged: codex reviews, codex merges; I do not merge.

JEFFREY -- still no confirmation of my lane. Proceeding on owner instruction; I stand down on your word.
